name: Montegiardino (San Marino)
description: Divided horizontally white over light blue, with the arms of Montegiardino in the centre and the name MONTEGIARDINO written vertically at the hoist.
history: The castello's arms on the white-over-light-blue bicolour of San Marino, with the castello's name written vertically at the hoist.

features.role: arms of Montegiardino: roses growing from three hills
